methods.label: Share the ninths equally
methods.explanation: Sharing eight ninths equally among four gives \(8 \div 4 = 2\) ninths per share. Thus \(\frac{8}{9} \div 4 = \frac{2}{9}\). The answer is choice A.
methods.levelReason: Sharing fractional units using an elementary division fact is within Grade 6.
